_doc: Kerbside parked cars (static props on Parking lanes). Read by wp_world::props (embedded at build time). Owner playtest row 77: Port Vesper v2 had ~3,300 parked cars; this table targets ~35-50 % of that. Walking along each parking lane: at every free slot a cluster of run[0]..=run[1] cars starts with probability `start` (per district; scaled by fast_street_scale on streets faster than fast_street_mps, i.e. collectors), bumper to bumper with bumper_gap_m between cars, then gap_car_lengths (random) of kerb stays empty, or, with empty_stretch_chance, a long empty stretch of empty_stretch_m (owner row 93: visible empty kerb). Never within junction_clear_m of a lane end (junctions and their crosswalks), poi_clear_m of a POI (garages, stations, race grids: the lot entrances), portal_clear_m of a tunnel portal, inside a tunnel or on a bridge deck (lane more than elevated_gap_m above the terrain), or on streets faster than max_speed_mps (arterials and highways have no parking lanes anyway).
